name: agentic-skills
description: Production agent skills open-sourced by ALYA Labs.

plugins.name: qa-sentinel
plugins.description: Goal-anchored adversarial verifier for any work an agent declares done. v1.0 redesign: reconstructs the actual acceptance criteria first, tries to FALSIFY the completion claim via independent channels, scales verification to change size, maintains a living qa-memory of human corrections (52-pattern failure catalog as seed corpus), renders calibrated verdicts with mandatory NOT-CHECKED disclosure, and runs sustained find-fix-verify iteration via /qa loop with fresh-context agents and a destructive-fix count-invariant gate.

plugins.name: deepdive
plugins.description: Recursive context processing engine that prevents quality degradation on complex, multi-source tasks. Based on Recursive Language Models (Zhang, Kraska & Khattab, MIT CSAIL, 2026).

plugins.name: premium-web-design
plugins.description: Create, refine, audit, or prototype frontend interfaces with high design quality. Modes: create (incl. --landing conversion pages), refine (polish/animate/colorize/overdrive), audit (technical + design + pre-launch CWV gate), prototype (multi-variant HTML, ad-channel schemas), onboard, mirror. Behavioral UX psychology as a core mechanic (smart defaults, goal gradient, reciprocity, endowment, loss aversion, anchoring — with an ethics guardrail). Two lanes: Admire (bold marketing UI) vs Operate (data-dense dashboards/tables/admin — contextual components, progressive disclosure, invisible UI, 4/8-pt grid, five states). 26 reference docs. Includes a proactive quick review and AI-slop detection.

plugins.name: autoskill
plugins.description: Analyze coding sessions to detect corrections and preferences, then propose targeted improvements to the skills in your own workspace. Edits stay local: nothing is pushed to any upstream repo.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Capture session state for seamless continuation. Generates structured handoff documents with goals, decisions, dead ends, suggested skills, and next steps. Optional argument tailors the handoff to the next session's purpose; redacts secrets and references other artifacts instead of duplicating them.

plugins.name: primer
plugins.description: Prime Claude with full project context at the start of a new session

plugins.name: idea-validation
plugins.description: Startup idea validation framework that opens with a fast 9-dimension serial-founder pre-screen (Build / Sleep-on-it / Pass gate) then runs 7 brutal stress-test prompts (VC reality check, angry customer simulation, pricing stress test, competitive teardown, founding team audit, 18-month survival sim, one-sentence pitch test) only if it passes. Produces a scored go/no-go validation report plus constructive pivots. Use when a founder, PM, or operator wants to gut-check a startup or business idea before committing resources.

plugins.name: brand-voice-generator
plugins.description: Generate tone-of-voice and brand-system files for use with the PPTX Generator and other brand-aware skills.
